name: [Control Hub] [Dev] Five Percent Reflection Delivery
_comment: DEVELOPMENT workflow. Webhook-triggered. App POSTs the five_percent_reflection.submitted payload from /api/performance/five-percent-reflections. Generates a one-page PDF in a Code node, always notifies the admin Telegram chat, and sends the PDF to the submitter via Gmail and/or Telegram when those channels are enabled.
